description: This source file contains the implementation of a singly linked list data structure, including methods for adding, removing, getting elements, and calculating size. It also defines an internal node class and a utility method to find the tail of the list.

classes.name: LinkedList
classes.description: A class representing a singly linked list with basic operation methods.

classes.name: Node
classes.description: An internal class representing a node in the linked list, containing data and a reference to the next node.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new element to the end of the linked list.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the first occurrence of the specified element from the list.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the list.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the element at the specified index.

methods.name: unlink
methods.description: Internal method to unlink a node from the list.

methods.name: tail
methods.description: Utility function to find the last node in the list starting from head.
